faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.more: Have another question? Call us, reception is open 24 hours.
faq.deposit.a: If a deposit is needed for your event, the offer we send you says how much it is and by when it must be paid.
faq.cancel.q: What if we need to cancel or change the date?
faq.cancel.a: The cancellation terms for your event are written in the offer we send you; our terms & cancellation cover stays. Call us as early as you can.
faq.parking.a: Yes, the hotel has on-site parking for guests.
faq.rooms.a: Yes. The hotel has 57 rooms and apartments, so guests travelling in can stay the night. Mention it in your enquiry and we'll include rooms in the offer.
faq.invoice.a: Yes. Send us the company's full name, address and tax number (EDB), and we issue an invoice for the event.
